interpretation: The product cancellation ordering regression is fixed and covered by Rust/egui tests. Native COM stage observation is reliable. Repeated-process conversion failures also reproduce in a standard WPF TextBox. Keeping Japanese language registration stable still yields first8pass/secondprocessfailure, so that alone is not the cause. Candidate UIA polling was unusable because the popup is outside the owned PID. The current diagnostic holds the same owned desktop grant across all GUI sessions and records remaining job processes before unchanged kill-on-close cleanup. No failed run is counted as passed.
